- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:255-272 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]

  WHY: A leading `2>&1` can leave the command segment malformed, so `git_subcommands` may not detect a push and the merged-PR guard can be bypassed.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:252-272 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_shell_segments_with_operators` can discard an all-digit command argument as though it were an I/O descriptor when it precedes a redirection operator.
  WHY: `git push origin 2 > /dev/null` can lose its refspec, causing `_push_targets()` to check the current branch instead of the intended target.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:262-270 | severity=high | confidence=[5]

  WHY: `git push origin 2 > /dev/null` can lose its refspec, causing `_push_targets()` to check the current branch instead of branch `2`.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:87-91, 806-811, 891-898 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Regression tests for leading-redirection and appended Git-directory assignment handling are absent, while existing tests still assert the old behavior.
  WHY: The missing coverage leaves guard regressions undetected, and the old assertions may fail when the guard asks for confirmation rather than blocking.
